items.headline:
FED HOLDS RATES, HAWKISH SPLIT EMERGES

The Federal Reserve left its benchmark rate unchanged at 3.50%–3.75%, saying inflation remains above its 2% target while the economy continues to expand at a solid pace.

The decision passed 9–3, with Hammack, Kashkari and Logan dissenting
